title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
abstract: arXiv:2610.31479v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. translated_title: 评估大语言模型推理优化在苹果芯片上的适用性
translated_abstract: 苹果芯片是本地大语言模型推理使用最广泛的平台之一，然而几乎所有的推理优化都是在服务器级NVIDIA GPU上、针对批量服务工作负载进行设计和验证的。当这些优化迁移到苹果芯片上时，哪些优化仍能保持其收益，又是什么因素决定了它们的适用性？我们评估了四类优化方法：KV缓存剪枝、投机解码、移植的GPU内核以及训练后量化。实验在四台苹果机器上进行，采用统一的单请求解码工作负载，并在可能的情况下与RTX 4090进行对等比较。KV缓存剪枝在苹果芯片上可实现最高1.75倍的端到端吞吐量提升，但在桌面级NVIDIA GPU上反而可能降低吞吐量。在统一基准测试下，所有被评估的投机解码方法在苹果芯片上均降低了吞吐量，尽管在服务器GPU上报告有2-6倍的收益。CUDA内核设计只能部分迁移：公开的Metal缺乏异步拷贝支持，且批量优……
tldr: 该论文系统评估了KV缓存剪枝、投机解码、移植GPU内核和训练后量化四类大语言模型推理优化在苹果芯片上的适用性，发现其表现与服务器级NVIDIA GPU上显著不同——KV缓存剪枝在苹果芯片上可将端到端吞吐量提升至多1.75倍，而投机解码反而会降低吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates four families of LLM inference optimizations (KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization) on Apple Silicon, revealing that their benefits differ markedly from server-class NVIDIA GPUs—KV-cache pruning can boost end-to-end throughput by up to 1.75x on Apple, while all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput.
